In play, it fires with @1547[2dg|1db]{Short Bow Shot}, dealing piercing damage while its traits emphasize aiming and narrow.

props.Description: The empty hand is the simplest weapon, relying on timing, leverage, and raw nerve rather than steel. It favors close control, sudden commitment, and whatever skill the body itself can bring. In play, it strikes with @1547[3dc]{Unarmed}, dealing blunt damage while its traits emphasize disarming, control, and fast.
